## Reduced scope: what this PR delivers

This PR was reduced to the finished work. **It does not complete #4550.** The full-suite acceptance on a supported runner and the final merged consumer-payload receipt moved to **#4557**, and #4550 stays open.

Kept:
- `tests/scripts/test_issue_pr_context.py`: fallback-token estimates are deterministic (`tiktoken` forced absent). Small-budget cases (-1, 0, 1, 2) and a tokenizer partial-heading case give real coverage.
- `.github/scripts/__tests__/keepalive-loop.test.js::replayCompletion` and `verifier-correction-artifacts.test.js::zip`: the real Python fixtures still run. Their small payloads go through argv, stdin is ignored, and each call has a 15s SIGKILL bound. The payload assertions are unchanged, and there is a new quoted/empty/binary archive regression.
- `tests/scripts/test_llm_client_shared.py`: async modes run the real LangChain chain under `asyncio.Runner`, with a heartbeat timer and a 10s `wait_for` bound. The response and prompt assertions are kept.
- `.github/scripts/__tests__/verifier-correction-coding.test.js`: Python stdin goes through a private 0600 file that is cleaned up afterwards, and every interpreter call must have a bound. New regressions cover quoted and Unicode text and budget overflow.
- `.github/scripts/maint71_merge_sync_prs.js::dispatchCandidateRefreshFromReport`: all report subjects are checked before any native read or recovery dispatch. A failed check emits a bounded `canary-refresh-subject-refusal` diagnostic (blocking N, drainable 0, at most 8 configured repositories, unknown repository text left out), and the `canary_refresh_report_subject_unknown` code is unchanged. Documented in `docs/ops/CONSUMER_REPO_MAINTENANCE.md`. Covered by `maint71-delivery-receipts.test.js`, together with the delivery-identity and historical-finding regressions and their retained fixtures under `docs/evidence/issue-4369/runtime-4550/`.
- Partial evidence, labelled as partial in `docs/evidence/issue-4369/2026-11-08-validation.md` § "Issue 4550: salvaged partial evidence":
  - targeted passing logs;
  - causal candidate receipts: Maint 68 42485644055 → Maint 71 42485792262 / 42485974523 → consumer PR 2486, with `merged=0`, so the payload is **not delivered**;
  - complete finite nonrecurrence observations: 49 comments, explicit UTC boundaries.

Removed (moved to #4557, still readable at `b2949e496`):
- the failed or timed-out full-suite logs and receipts;
- the CI selftest full-suite receipts;
- blocker-comment drafts;
- the long working narrative;
- the bootstrap file.

## Validation (local, reduced branch 154858c48)

- `node --test .github/scripts/__tests__/{keepalive-loop,verifier-correction-artifacts,verifier-correction-coding,maint71-delivery-receipts,maint71_merge_sync_prs,scoped-canary-refresh}.test.js`: 614 passed, 0 failed (8.4s)
- `python3 -m pytest -q -n 4 tests/scripts/test_issue_pr_context.py tests/scripts/test_llm_client_shared.py tests/scripts/test_issue_4369_delivery_lifecycle.py tests/scripts/test_issue_4369_downstream_evidence.py`: 251 passed (20.1s)
- `black --check` and `ruff check` on the touched Python tests: clean
- The full suite was not run locally (closer rule). It belongs to #4557.
